title: Stripe has no API to delete a Price, and deleting its Product then fails
symptoms: AttributeError: type object 'Price' has no attribute 'delete'
This product cannot be deleted because it has one or more user-created prices.
cause: The Prices API supports no deletion, and a Product can only be deleted while it has no prices attached.
fix: Archive instead: set active to false on the price, and on the product if you want it hidden too.
apply:
await stripe.prices.update(priceId, { active: false });
await stripe.products.update(productId, { active: false });
affected: Stripe Prices and Products API, all versions through 2026-09-30.endive
